summary: A short note about the song "Cry" (titled "Song Cry" in the note). It reports that Jay-Z, in an interview with Bill Maher, said the song was inspired by three different past relationships. He wrote about each of these experiences in separate verses.
one_line: Note on the song "Cry", whose inspiration Jay-Z described in an interview with Bill Maher.
key_facts: The note is titled "Song Cry" and is sourced from Wikipedia.
Jay-Z stated in an interview with Bill Maher that the song was inspired by three different relationships he had in the past.
Jay-Z wrote about his different experiences together in different verses of the song.
